_note: Owner 25.09.2026 (after the reference concept of 26.09.): every source declares the ISA-95 functional level (IEC 62264-1) of the system it reads; the level decides which ISA-95 part its objects belong to. Here the ERP (sim-v5) and the PLCs report Part 2 objects; a Level-3 MES would report Part 4 (work) objects. Checked by lint-functional-level. 25.09.2026 (owner, after research): exactly as strict as the norm — ANSI/ISA-95.00.05-2018 (Part 5) defines the transactions between Levels 3 and 4 and within Level 3 for the objects of Part 2 AND Part 4 (scope; clause 6.17 work calendar), so a Level-3 or Level-4 source may report Part 2 and Part 4 objects. ISA-95 does not regulate Level 2; its entry is our own convention, not the norm.
